title: The "Payment" HTTP Authentication Scheme (draft-httpauth-payment-00)
quote: Servers MUST return 402 with a WWW-Authenticate: Payment header when payment is required or when a payment credential fails validation. ... This specification REQUIRES TLS 1.2 or later for all Payment authentication flows. ... Payment methods used with this specification MUST provide single-use proof semantics. ... Servers MUST NOT perform side effects (database writes, external API calls) for requests that have not been paid. ... [authors: Tempo Labs + Stripe; dated 3 June 2026, expires 5 December 2026; Standards Track intended status].

title: The "Payment" HTTP Authentication Scheme — IETF Datatracker
quote: This document defines the 'Payment' HTTP authentication scheme, enabling HTTP resources to require a payment challenge to be fulfilled before access. The scheme extends HTTP Authentication, using the HTTP 402 'Payment Required' status code. [Individual draft; not endorsed by the IETF and has no formal standing in the IETF standards process; versions 00 and 01; last updated 17 March 2026; expires 19 September 2026; IESG state I-D Exists.]

title: tempoxyz/mpp-specs — Specifications for the Machine Payments Protocol
quote: Specifications for the Machine Payments Protocol - powered by the "Payment" HTTP authentication scheme.

title: MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) documentation for Cloudflare Agents — the 'Payment' HTTP authentication scheme over HTTP 402 for agentic payments.

title: What Is MPP? The Machine Payments Protocol by Tempo Explained
quote: MPP ships with two production methods: Tempo (stablecoin payments) and Stripe (cards, wallets, and other traditional payment methods), and a server can advertise both simultaneously. MPP is backward-compatible with x402 at the charge layer.

title: x402 vs MPP: Comparing Agent Payment Protocols
quote: MPP uses 402 consistently for all payment-related challenges, including when a credential fails validation, which differs from other HTTP authentication schemes that use 401 for failed credentials. ... MPP is backwards compatible with x402, as the core x402 'exact' payment flow maps directly onto MPP's charge intent.

title: MPP payments — Stripe Documentation
quote: Stripe documentation for MPP (Machine Payments Protocol) payments — enabling agents to pay over HTTP via the Payment authentication scheme using Stripe as a payment method.

title: What is MPP? Dual Payment Protocol
quote: MPP activates HTTP's dormant 402 status code with a challenge-response payment flow, separating the core authentication scheme from per-method specifications (Tempo, Stripe, Solana, Card) and intents (charge, session).
